messages:
Priya Sharma: Heads-up — planning a small schema merge + incremental backfill tonight during the quiet window. Target start 23:00 UTC, ~30m slot. Will be toggling dual-write for users.profile -> users_v2 and running a short backfill for missing flags.
Diego Ramos: Who is taking the deploy owner on this? I can be standby but will be on a call earlier.
Marta Ivanov: I can own the rollout and monitor. ETA I'm online from 22:45 UTC. Will do preflight checks at 22:55.
Samir Patel: Thx Marta. I'll handle the smoke test script and rollback steps. Leaving notes here for quick copy.
Priya Sharma: Awesome. Checklist: 1) preflight query counts (see below) 2) switch dual-write flag 3) run backfill limited to 1h batches 4) smoke app traffic 5) monitor metrics + rollback if errors.
Samir Patel: Preflight queries: ```-- quick sanity counts
SELECT count(1) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
SELECT count(1) FROM users_v2 WHERE migrated = true LIMIT 1;```
Samir Patel: Smoke test (dev) curl: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/v1/users/health` expecting 200 and latency <200ms.
Marta Ivanov: Rollback plan: flip dual-write flag back to false, cancel backfill job, and run quick cleanup to mark incomplete rows. Rollback signal will be `@marta rollback-now` in this channel.
Diego Ramos: How do we surface failures? Which alerts to watch?
Priya Sharma: Watch these dashboards: "users-write-errors", "backfill-failure-rate", and the per-replica lag. I'll pin links in the console. Also we'll watch SLO traces and the deployment stream.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by Marta Ivanov for 23:00 UTC — tags: schema/2026-03-users-v2, backfill/incremental-1h
Marta Ivanov: I'll run a canary for first 5 minutes (1% traffic) then ramp to 50% -> 100% if stable. If error rate >1% or latency >500ms, we pause and call rollback.
Samir Patel: Smoketest command after cutover: `python tools/smoketests/run.py --route /users --concurrency 5 --checks status,latency` — will post results here.
Diego Ramos: I'm happy to run the manual verification for a subset of user IDs and confirm consistency between users and users_v2. Ping me when canary starts.
Priya Sharma: Last checks: confirm read replicas are caught up (replica_lag < 5s), ensure backups taken (snapshot at 22:50 UTC), and feature flag TTL set to 2h to avoid long dual-write bleed.
Marta Ivanov: Backups confirmed at 22:50. Replicas <2s. Feature flag TTL set. Ready to proceed.
Diego Ramos: :thumbsup: Good to go from my side.
Samir Patel: I'll post the smoke script output and a short JSON summary every 5m during the canary. If anything looks off I'll add :rotating_light: and escalate.
Priya Sharma: OK starting countdown. Marta, trigger at 23:00 and call it out here.
Marta Ivanov: Triggering now. deploy-bot: start deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Marta Ivanov — step 1/4 toggle dual-write ON.
Samir Patel: Smoketests running — first run shows 200 OK for 100/100 requests, p95 latency 120ms. Posting logs shortly.
deploy-bot: canary started — 1% traffic.
Marta Ivanov: Canary green at 5m. Ramping to 50%.
Samir Patel: Smoketests all green at 5m and 10m. No increase in error-rate.
Marta Ivanov: Ramped to 100%. Backfill job started with rate limit to 500 rows/min.
Priya Sharma: Monitoring dashboards look clean. No spike in write errors, replica lag steady.
Diego Ramos: Quick check on data parity for sample IDs shows consistent fields.
Samir Patel: Backfill progress: 12% complete. ETA ~40m for the target set. Posting progress every 10m.
Marta Ivanov: All good here. Will keep channel updated. If we need to rollback I'll execute the `rollback-now` command mentioned above and call an ops huddle.
Priya Sharma: Thanks team. If any :rotating_light: escalate to oncall and ping infra-sre. Otherwise will close the window once backfill reaches 100% and we verify post-migration smoke.
Samir Patel: Confirming final post-migration smoke will run after backfill completes. I'll post final summary and close. :white_check_mark:
